results.title: Morocco World Cup 2026 Team Analysis, Squad, Tactics & Group C Outlook
highlights:
Morocco enter the 2026 FIFA World Cup as the first African and Arab nation ever to reach a World Cup semi-final. The Atlas Lions are drawn in Group C with Brazil, Haiti and Scotland, giving them a difficult but realistic path toward another knockout-stage run.
[...]
This Morocco World Cup 2026 team analysis covers the squad outlook, tactical profile, key players, Group C fixtures, opponent matchups, strengths, weaknesses and tournament prediction.
[...]
-final run
[...]
The coaching change adds a major storyline. Walid Regragui built the historic 2022 team, but Mohamed Ouahbi now has to protect that identity while refreshing the squad and managing a demanding Group C. Brazil are the headline opponent, but Scotland and Haiti are also important fixtures for qualification.
[...]
Morocco are in Group C with Brazil, Haiti and Scotland. The group opens with one of the most difficult tests possible against Brazil, but the schedule still gives Morocco a clear route toward qualification.
[...]
The Brazil match will shape the group's emotional tone, but Scotland and Haiti may be more decisive for qualification. Morocco should aim to stay competitive in the opener, then secure the points needed in the final two fixtures.
[...]
s defensive block
[...]
Morocco have a strong chance to qualify from Group C. Brazil may be the favorite to win the group, but Morocco have enough quality and tournament experience to compete for second place or challenge for first if the opener goes well.
[...]

[...]

[...]
A draw or competitive performance against Brazil followed by a win over Scotland would put Morocco in a strong position. Even with a loss to Brazil, six points from the final two matches should be enough to progress.
[...]
Morocco's realistic target is reaching the knockout stage and competing for a Round of 16 win. Given their 2022 semi-final run, expectations are higher than before, but repeating that achievement will be extremely difficult.
[...]
If Morocco maintain their defensive structure and the coaching transition is smooth, they can become one of the most dangerous knockout opponents in the tournament. Their ability to frustrate stronger teams remains a major weapon.
[...]
World Cup 2
[...]
Overall outlook: Morocco should be considered a strong candidate to progress from Group C. Their tournament ceiling depends on defensive consistency, Hakimi's influence, Bounou's form and whether Ouahbi can preserve the 2022 identity while adding more attacking variety.
